simple.meaning: זַרְזִיף (zarzîyph) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a pouring rain.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 72:6. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זַרְזִיף (H2222) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: זַרְזִיף (zarzîyph) / H2222 is traced through Psalms 72:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2222. zarziph זַרְזִיף Psa 72:6 see זרף . [ זָרַף ] verb probably drip (compare either Arabic shed tears, or Aramaic imber vehemens ) — Hiph`il יַזְרִיף read in Psa 72:6 by Hup Bi Che (for זַרְזִיף ) followed by אָ֑רֶץ cause to drip, irrigate. זַרְזִיף noun [masculine] drop, dripping (Late Hebrew id. ; on form (if Genuine) compare Nö M 85, NS 191 ) — Psa 72:6 ז ׳כִּרְבִיבִים אָ֑רֶץ as showers, a dripping of the earth, but see foregoing.
definitions.rootNote: by reduplication from an unused root meaning to flow;

occurrences.englishText: He will come down like rain on the mown grass,
